title: Three senior executives who helped launch OpenAI's Stargate initiative are leaving, sources say to join the same new company (Anissa Gardizy/The Information)
summary: Anissa Gardizy / The Information: Three senior executives who helped launch OpenAI's Stargate initiative are leaving, sources say to join the same new company — Three senior OpenAI executives who helped launch the company's original Stargate data center initiative have left or are preparing to depart the ChatGPT maker in the coming days …
